suggestions: I'm grateful for the serene stillness before Subuh, giving me a moment of clarity and peace before the day kicks into high gear.
I'm thankful for that deeply satisfying feeling when a production deployment goes live smoothly without a single critical alert.
I'm grateful for an impromptu mamak catch-up and a warm glass of teh tarik with close friends after a demanding week.
I'm thankful for finally tracking down and squashing that elusive edge-case bug that had been evading the team for days.
I'm grateful for the continuous rezeki of having a stable job that challenges my intellect and allows me to build meaningful things.
I'm thankful for a calm Friday afternoon, taking a mindful break for Jumaat prayers and returning to work with a reset mind.
I'm grateful for a gentle morning rain that cooled down the room and made working from home so much cozier.
I'm thankful for patient, supportive teammates who take the time to leave thoughtful, constructive feedback on my pull requests.
I'm grateful for sharing a simple, warm home-cooked dinner with my family after a long day of staring at screens.
I'm thankful for the quiet focus time in the afternoon when all my unit tests pass cleanly on the first pipeline run.
I'm grateful for a crisp roti canai breakfast that set an easy, uplifting tone for the start of my day.
I'm thankful for the energy and mental bandwidth to keep upskilling and exploring new tech stacks in my free time.
I'm grateful for a smooth, hassle-free commute on the LRT with an open seat where I could just rest and listen to a podcast.
I'm thankful for the barakah in my daily routine, helping me balance sprint deadlines, family time, and spiritual obligations.
I'm grateful for the relief of closing out the last ticket of the sprint early so I can unplug and completely rest over the weekend.
